name: Home Upgrade Services
description: No-cost installation services for income-eligible homeowners to convert gas appliances to electric, and fixed-price full-service installation for other homeowners; includes assessment, pre-vetted contractor, permits, and rebates
fullDescription: WestLight Energy's (formerly Peninsula Clean Energy) Full-Service Home Upgrade program offers fixed-price electrification for homeowners, and no-cost upgrades for income-eligible homeowners, converting gas appliances to electric from assessment to installation.
whatTheyOffer:
- Free in-home assessment
- No-cost installation for income-qualified homeowners; fixed, pre-negotiated pricing for everyone else
- Heat pump water heaters and HVAC systems (project must include one)
- Induction cooktops, electric washers/dryers, EV charging, insulation and air sealing
- Electrical upgrades if needed
- Permits and rebate applications handled for you
- Pre-vetted contractors
howToGetIt:
1. Complete the online application
2. Must be a WestLight Energy customer who owns and lives in a single-family home (up to a fourplex) with gas appliances
3. For no-cost upgrades: home under 2,000 sq ft, income at or below 80% AMI (San Mateo County: $117,700 for 1 person, $168,100 for 4), investable assets under $500,000, and no other properties owned; CalFresh, CalWORKs, ESA and similar programs can prove eligibility
4. Schedule free in-home assessment
5. Review and approve your Home Upgrade Proposal
6. WestLight Energy's contractor handles permits and installation
keywords: home upgrade, electrification, free, WestLight Energy, Peninsula Clean Energy, PCE, San Mateo, heat pump, induction, electric dryer, low-income
